# Wings

> Block editor for notes with nested pages, LaTeX math, Excalidraw drawings, and a BYOK AI panel. Keep page bodies in a local vault on this device, or share by link. Export markdown. Sign in with Google or magic link.

Wings is a private journal product. User notes and share links are not for crawling. Use the pages below for product facts.

## Product

- [Home](https://wings.nopejs.me/): Product overview and sign-in entry
- [Pricing](https://wings.nopejs.me/pricing): Free today; paid plans planned
- [About](https://wings.nopejs.me/about): What Wings is and how it is built
- [Roadmap](https://wings.nopejs.me/roadmap): Shipped, in progress, and exploring
- [Docs](https://wings.nopejs.me/docs): Auth, local vault, sharing, export, AI BYOK, keyboard, FAQ
- [Docs (markdown)](https://wings.nopejs.me/docs.md): Same docs as markdown
